release_notes:
SGB Browser v2.0.41 Official Complete Release:
• Permanent Crash-Immunity & Low-Spec Multi-Browser Stability Engine (core/stability_guard.py): Eliminated Qt6Core.dll (0xC0000409) QThread dialog-close crashes across MainWindow & all 7 bots, added Universal Playwright & Chromium Low-RAM Flag Optimizer (smooth 8–10 simultaneous browsers on 4GB–8GB RAM PCs without 0xE0000008 OOM crashes), Active Child Chromium Working-Set RAM Trimmer, Staggered Browser Launch Gate, Non-Blocking Background Cookie Sync (eliminates 'Not Responding' freezes), Safe 500-Line Rolling Log Caps across all bots, and Windows-hardened Atomic JSON I/O.
• Exhaustive Zero-Repeat 3-Minute VPN Auto-Rotation Engine: Tracks every verified public Exit IP in a persistent per-country ledger (zero 42-item cap) with /24 subnet diversity — once an IP is used it NEVER repeats until 100% of live unique IPs in that country have been exhausted (and even on cycle wrap-around, strictly excludes the immediately previous IP). Added persistent Main-Window 3-minute auto-rotator with live in-place GlobalSuiteVpnBridge hot-sync so active browsers switch cleanly to every fresh IP.
• Strict Country-Locked Independent Premium VPN Architecture: Main Top-Bar Global VPN (applies software-wide to Profile Manager + Bots #1–#7 including Headless mode) and Bot #7 Independent Premium VPN (overrides Main Global VPN like a browser extension without affecting Main Global VPN) — rotating NEVER drifts outside the selected country.
• Added Functional Launch 'Delay: [2s]' Control (0s–60s) right beside 'Threads:' in Bot #7 ('FB Forget Browser'), staggering multi-thread browser launches and inter-session rotation across all 7 engine modes.
• Unified Browser Display Controls: Replaced all '👁️ Visible' / '🙈 Internal' buttons and 'View: Show Browser / Headless' dropdown with a single clean standard '☑️ Headless' checkbox right beside 'Threads:' & 'Delay:' across all bots.
• Fixed Critical Bot #7 Premium VPN Pre-Flight Failover Crash ('_HAS_PREMIUM_VPN_MGR') & Zero-Burn Queue Guard: untouched phone numbers are now automatically restored to 'Intact' on any pre-flight failure with a 3-fail Auto-Pause circuit breaker so ZERO numbers can ever be skipped or burned.
• Upgraded Surfshark Multi-Thread Tunnel Engine: Fixed HTTP/2 SSLSocket deadlock, replaced burst-auth probes with Zero-Credential HTTP-Proxy filtering (eliminates 407/403 account throttling), added Compare-And-Swap failover, HTTPS-First Unlimited Pre-Flight Probes, Per-Thread Distinct Exit IPs, and Instant Exit-IP Blacklist Eviction.
• Fixed 'PC VPN / Direct' HUD Telemetry under 10+ Concurrent Threads: added 8s TTL caching + unlimited HTTPS fallback chain + 90s grace retention so Location & Consistency never flash false 'Offline / Unreachable' or 'Disconnected' while online.
• Polished Bot #7 Premium VPN Toolbar into a spacious dedicated sub-row (zero truncated labels/dropdowns) & paused background Auto-Timer Rotation while '⏸ Pause' is active.
• Added Top Toolbar '🔐 Premium VPN' Global Control Center (replacing '🥷 Team'), 7-Mode Anti-Detect Engine, 4th Sub-Tab '🛡️ PP Checker', Persistent Queue, Universal '⏸ Pause' / '▶ Resume', and 100% Official Bot #1 .srx preservation.
